name: Facelift Cloud
description_en:
Facelift Cloud is the catalog name for Facelift’s hosted social media suite. Current packaging includes Orchestrate, Engage, Analyze, Amplify and other components; this profile concentrates on Orchestrate’s planning, post sets, templates and review process, with documented access and reporting dependencies. It is a team operating environment rather than simply a calendar of scheduled messages.

The main evaluation task is moving a brand’s idea through channel-specific preparation, approval, publication and inspection of each profile’s result. Team assignments determine available content while permission sets determine allowed operations. Current package names and older Publisher/Cloud articles coexist, so a buyer should confirm enabled modules and actual account behavior before assuming every suite label or historical help example belongs to their contract.
description_zh:
Facelift Cloud 是目录对 Facelift 托管社交媒体套件的名称。当前组合包含 Orchestrate、Engage、Analyze、Amplify 等组件。本文聚焦 Orchestrate 的规划、Post Set、模板及审阅流程，并覆盖有文档的访问、报告依赖。它是团队运营环境，而不只是计划消息日历。

主要评估任务是把品牌想法推进至渠道专属准备、审批、发布，再检查每个账户结果。团队分配决定可用内容，Permission Set 决定可执行操作。当前组合名与旧 Publisher／Cloud 文章并存，购买者应确认启用模块及真实账户行为，不能假设每个套件标签或历史示例都属于其合约。

core_features.explanation_en: Prepare content for selected networks and profiles.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为所选网络及账户准备内容。

core_features.explanation_en: Scope reviewers, stages and deadline behavior to content.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按内容配置审阅者、阶段及期限行为。

core_features.explanation_en: Apply a prepared template’s settings to a new post.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将预备模板设置应用至新帖。

core_features.explanation_en: Inspect which destination failed and its error reason.
core_features.explanation_zh: 检查失败目的地及错误原因。

en: Coordinate a distributed brand’s post-set approval and publication responsibilities.
Reuse prepared content templates while reviewing each generated post.
Investigate partial publishing failure and connection ownership.
zh: 协调分布式品牌 Post Set 审批与发布职责。
复用预备内容模板，同时逐项检查生成帖子。
调查部分发布失败及连接责任人。

steps.en: Map team content assignments and permission sets.
steps.zh: 绘制团队内容分配及 Permission Set。

steps.en: Create a controlled draft and inspect network-specific settings.
steps.zh: 创建可控草稿并检查网络专属设置。

steps.en: Verify the strategy deadline and force-approval behavior.
steps.zh: 验证策略期限及强制批准行为。

steps.en: Review overdue approvals before taking an action.
Inspect each native result and the profile publication history.
steps.zh: 逐项检查原生结果及账户发布历史。

items.en: Scheduled edits require pause and rescheduling.
items.zh: 计划内容编辑需暂停及重新排程。

items.en: Approval can be optional, forced or automatic on deadline, depending on configuration.
items.zh: 按配置，审批可为可选、强制通过或期限自动通过。
迟到／无日期审批可能立即发布。

items.en: Some reported zero metrics are documented API gaps, not verified zero performance.
items.zh: 部分零指标是文档 API 缺口，不是经验证的零效果。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current Professional, Business and Enterprise plans are all on request. Cards advertise unlimited users with an asterisk; final account/profile, module, support and usage terms were not verified. Business explicitly adds custom approvals and advanced user/team controls; Enterprise lists SSO, audit log and custom retention. No amount or sustainable free entitlement was confirmed. The flattened comparison table is not sufficient to assign every listed feature to every tier; request the actual contracted scope.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前 Professional、Business、Enterprise 全部询价。卡片以星号标注不限用户，最终账户／模块、支持及用量条款未核实。Business 明确增加自定义审批、进阶用户／团队控制，Enterprise 列 SSO、审计日志及自定义保留。未确认金额或可持续免费资格。扁平提取的对照表不足以把每项功能分配至每档，应取得实际签约范围。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Map content access separately from editing permissions
sections.title_zh: 分别绘制内容访问及编辑权限
sections.en: Teams determine access to profiles, posts and templates; permission sets constrain areas and actions. Moving a team changes its hierarchy while retaining users and objects. Deletion requires transferring members/objects first, and subteams move up rather than being discarded. Editorial multi-brand setup: assign profiles where needed, then verify which users can create, review or publish. A team’s existence alone does not demonstrate the necessary area permission, and broad team membership can affect who qualifies as a reviewer.
sections.zh: 团队决定账户、帖子、模板访问，Permission Set 限制区域及动作。移动团队改变层级，保留用户及对象。删除前需转移成员／对象，子团队向上移动而非一并删除。编辑多品牌设置建议：按需分配账户，再检查谁可创建、审阅、发布。存在团队本身不证明具备区域权限，宽泛成员关系也影响审阅者资格。

sections.title_en: Distinguish Save, Schedule and Get approval
sections.title_zh: 区分 Save、Schedule 及 Get approval
sections.en: A post set has network-specific content and selected profiles, with optional campaign, event, tags and owner. Save produces an unpublished draft. Scheduled dates must be at least 15 minutes and at most 12 months ahead; leaving the date blank permits direct publication. Planned content must be paused before editing, then rescheduled. Editorial launch preparation: verify destination tabs and final action, and keep internal briefing material separate from audience-facing text. A file warning or preview does not establish a successful native-platform publication.
sections.zh: Post Set 包含网络专属内容、所选账户，可加活动、事件、标签及负责人。Save 生成未发布草稿。计划日期需至少提前 15 分钟、最多 12 个月；不填日期可直接发布。Planned 内容须暂停后编辑，再重新排程。编辑发布准备建议：检查目的地页签及最终动作，把内部 Briefing 与面向受众文字分开。文件警告或预览不能证明原生平台成功发布。

sections.title_en: Approval behavior depends on strategy and force permissions
sections.title_zh: 审批行为取决于策略及强制权限
sections.en: Strategies combine network/profile scope, requesting users/teams and permitted approvers. Adding dedicated approvers individually creates AND, while adding them together creates OR. Deadline expiration rejects by default, but Auto approve steps on deadline expiration reverses that outcome. Force Accept can bypass requested reviewers unless disabled for the advanced strategy; optional approval is also configurable. Editorial acceptance: verify the intended scope, deadline action and force setting before relying on the review chain. The presence of an approval screen does not establish mandatory human sign-off for every post.
sections.zh: 策略结合网络／账户范围、请求者团队及允许审阅者。逐个添加指定审阅者形成 AND，一次一起添加形成 OR。期限到期默认拒绝，但 Auto approve steps on deadline expiration 会改为批准。Force Accept 可绕过指定审阅者，除非高级策略禁用；也可设可选审批。编辑验收建议：依赖审阅链前检查目标范围、期限动作及强制设置。存在审批界面不证明所有帖子必有人签核。

sections.title_zh: 迟到的批准可能立即发布
sections.en: The current dashboard separates Action Required, Awaiting Approval and Completed. A deadline comes from the strategy and can trigger automatic approval/rejection. Where publication timing governs, approval before the planned time waits until that time; approval afterward publishes immediately, as does approval without a publication time. Editorial event announcement: inspect both deadline and publication date before approving an overdue request. Resurfacing an old request is not evidence that its event information remains appropriate to publish now.
sections.zh: 当前仪表盘区分 Action Required、Awaiting Approval、Completed。期限来自策略，可触发自动批准／拒绝。由发布时间决定时，提前批准会等到计划时间，之后批准立即发布，没有发布时间的批准也立即发布。编辑活动公告建议：批准过期请求前同时检查审批期限及发布时间。旧请求重新出现，不代表其活动信息仍适合现在发布。

sections.title_en: A template supplies settings, not an automatic recurring campaign
sections.title_zh: 模板提供设置，并非自动重复活动
sections.en: Templates visible through team assignment can populate a new post’s channels, pages, text and files; the editor can adjust and schedule or save it. Their configured time period controls template availability to colleagues rather than the new post’s publication time. Creating a template notifies assigned teams, including users added later. Editorial recurring update: prepare a reusable structure, then review dates, assets and account selection on each derived post. A shared template is not proof that revisions propagate to already-created posts.
sections.zh: 团队分配控制可见模板，模板可填充新帖渠道、页面、文字及文件，编辑可调整后排程或保存。其时段控制对同事的模板可用期，不是新帖发布时间。创建模板通知分配团队，之后新加入者也会收到。编辑周期更新建议：建立复用结构，每次生成内容再检查日期、素材及账户。共享模板不能证明修改会传播到已有帖子。

sections.title_en: Profile authorization and platform administration are separate
sections.title_zh: 账户授权与平台管理是两层关系
sections.en: A valid token allows Facelift to act on a connected profile. The guide lists password, native permission and account-status changes as possible invalidation causes and says expiry cannot always be predicted. Refresh Connection must be completed by an appropriately authorized native-platform admin, independently of Facelift administration. Notification setup also needs a profile owner plus the owner’s enabled alert. Editorial ownership plan: document who can restore each connection and inspect the actual failed action after refresh; no guaranteed automatic replay was verified.
sections.zh: 有效令牌让 Facelift 操作已连接账户。指南列出密码、原生权限及账户状态变化等失效原因，并说明不总能预测到期。Refresh Connection 需由具有原生平台权限的管理者完成，独立于 Facelift 管理身份。通知还需指定 Profile Owner，并由其启用提醒。编辑责任规划：记录谁能恢复各连接，刷新后检查真实失败动作；未核实保证自动重放。

sections.title_en: Inspect each destination before duplicating failed content
sections.title_zh: 复制失败内容前逐目的地检查
sections.en: A Failed post set can have successful destinations. Its overview provides green/red results per profile, errors and publication history. The troubleshooting guide recommends duplicating and rescheduling some temporary Facebook failures and refreshing invalid authorization for token errors. Those examples do not diagnose every failure automatically. Editorial recovery: inspect the native results and failed profile, fix the specific condition, then deliberately prepare only the required resend. No atomic cross-network rollback, universal retry policy or exactly-once guarantee was verified.
sections.zh: Failed Post Set 可能含成功目的地。概览按账户提供绿／红结果、错误及发布历史。故障指南对部分临时 Facebook 错误建议复制重排，对令牌错误建议刷新授权。这些示例不能自动诊断所有失败。编辑恢复建议：检查原生结果及失败账户，修复具体条件，再有意准备所需重发。未核实跨网络原子回滚、通用重试策略或仅一次保证。

sections.title_en: Planner deletion, native removal and emergency stop differ
sections.title_zh: Planner 删除、原生移除及紧急停止不同
sections.en: Draft/Rejected items can be removed from Planner; Planned requires stopping first, and Pending requires rejection. Successful/Failed are final statuses retained in Planner. Native deletion through the documented control is Facebook-specific. Company Admin Stop Publications resets Facelift-created future organic posts and those in approval to Draft; Facebook ads require separate handling. Editorial crisis response: inspect organic drafts, native published content and paid activity independently. The guide does not establish that the stop creates a lasting prohibition against newly scheduled content.
sections.zh: Draft／Rejected 可从 Planner 删除，Planned 需先停止，Pending 需先拒绝。Successful／Failed 是保留在 Planner 的终态。文档控件的原生删除专用于 Facebook。Company Admin 的 Stop Publications 把 Facelift 创建的未来自然内容及审批中内容重置为 Draft，Facebook 广告需另处理。编辑危机建议：分别检查自然内容草稿、原生已发布内容及付费活动。指南未确定停止会永久禁止之后新排程。

sections.title_en: A zero can represent unavailable provider data
sections.title_zh: 零可能代表平台数据不可用
sections.en: Post Performance offers profile/type/date/tag filters, team-visible saved views and CSV export. Column summaries default to averages and can change to sum/minimum/maximum, so totals need a named aggregation. The 2024 guide says promoted Instagram Reels can show zero reach/impressions because those fields are not supplied, while some other engagement fields are available. Treat that as a documented data caveat to verify in the account, not proof of no audience. Editorial comparison: keep paid/organic scope, date range and metric definition aligned before selecting a “top” post.
sections.zh: Post Performance 提供账户／类型／日期／标签筛选、团队共享视图及 CSV。列摘要默认平均值，可改总和／最小／最大，因此报告要说明聚合方式。2024 指南说付费推广 Instagram Reels 未取得部分字段时触达／展示为零，另有部分互动字段。这是需在账户核对的数据缺口，不能证明无人观看。编辑比较建议：选择“最佳”帖子前统一付费／自然范围、日期及指标定义。

seo.title_en: Facelift Cloud: post sets, approval deadlines and failure handling
seo.title_zh: Facelift Cloud：Post Set、审批期限及失败处理
seo.description_en: Examine Facelift Orchestrate drafts, approval overrides, templates, partial publishing failures, analytics gaps and quoted plans.
seo.description_zh: 核对 Facelift Orchestrate 草稿、审批覆盖、模板、部分发布失败、分析缺口及询价套餐。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Facelift team publishing and approval operations
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Final quoted prices, trial conditions, unlimited-user asterisk details and exact plan/add-on entitlements were not confirmed.
research_gaps.zh: 未确认最终报价、试用条件、不限用户星号细则及准确套餐／附加资格。

research_gaps.en: Provider-specific token expiry and historical API data limits were not independently revalidated with each network.
research_gaps.zh: 未向每个平台独立重新验证令牌期限及历史 API 数据限制。

research_gaps.en: Automatic failure replay, template revision propagation, API contract and persistent emergency-stop behavior remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 自动失败重放、模板修改传播、API 契约及持续紧急停止行为未核实。

research_gaps.en: Source licence, self-hosting, exact UI-language list, regional availability and hands-on publication or performance measurements were not verified. Intercom/font licence text belongs to help infrastructure, not the Facelift service.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实源码许可、自托管、准确界面语言清单、地区可用性及实际发布／效果测量。Intercom／字体许可文字属于帮助基础设施，不是 Facelift 服务许可。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
